Figure 41 shows the DSC of the Derakane resin systems which indicates the curing temperature was around 200 °C, Figure 42. The curing reaction time was approximately 2 to 4 min. Panels were consolidated with both the resin systems at 111 psi at 205 °C for 3 min. Fibers were wetted out and plates were to be used for composites evaluation. Derakane 780 ` Derakane 782 Figure 42.DSC test results for Derakane 780 and 782 respectively. 35 The viscosity profile of the resins DERAKANE 780 and DERAKANE 782 was also studied. All the measurements were performed at room temperature and humidity, and one atm pressure. Viscosity was measured at four intervals after mixing the resin: 0, 15, 30 and 45 min. Figure 43 illustrates the viscosity profiles. Derakane 782 was slightly more viscous than 780 resin system. Wet out of carbon fibers was similar in both the resins. Due to higher viscosity of 782, less squeeze out was observed. Derakane 780 wetted out the carbon fiber with less effort than 782.
